'''Red cross fudge''' is a delicious, easy fudge that works every time and never crystallizes.

== Ingredients ==
* 4½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (1 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]] / 2.2 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]]) white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* {{convert|0.5|lb|g}} [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 1½ cups (375 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 12.7 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Condensed Milk|evaporated milk]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract
* 2 cups (120 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 4.2 oz) miniature [[Cookbook:Marshmallow|marshmallows]]
* 12 oz (340 g) real [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate chips]]
* 2 cups (120 g / 4.2 oz) [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]]

== Procedure ==

# Combine sugar, butter, evaporated milk, and vanilla in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] and bring to a rolling [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# Cook on medium heat for 11 minutes, stirring constantly.
# Add marshmallows, chocolate chips, walnuts to fudge and mix well.
# Pour into a buttered pan and let cool. 
# Cut into squares when it cuts without melting back together but before it becomes crumbly. 
# Store in an air-tight container.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* Substituting margarine for butter makes the fudge oily. Imitation vanilla affects the aroma.
* Other varieties of chips (vanilla, butterscotch, etc.) work as well.
